segments.text: Listening Test In the listening test, you will be asked
to demonstrate how well you understand spoken English.
The entire listening test will last approximately 45 minutes.
There are four parts and directions are given for each part.
You must mark your answers on the separate answer sheet.
Do not write your answers in your test book.
Part 1.
Directions For each question in this part, you will
hear four statements about a picture in your test book.
When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what
you see in the picture.
Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer.
The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Now part 1 will begin.
Number 1.
Look at the picture marked number 1 in your test book.
A. Some baskets are hanging from a rack.
B. Some boxes are piled on the floor.
C. Some towels are stacked on shelves.
D. A sign is leaning against a wall.
Number 2. Look at the picture marked number 2 in your test book.
A. They're looking out a window.
B. They're holding onto a railing.
C. They're carrying a box downstairs.
D. They're sweeping the steps.
Number 3. Look at the picture marked number 3 in your test book.
A. A crate has been filled with bottles.
B. Some lamps are hanging from a pole.
C. A shopper is filling a bag.
D. Some goods have been set out on tables.
Number 4. Look at the picture marked number 4 in your test book.
A. She's preparing some food.
B. She's sweeping a floor.
C. She's closing a door.
D. She's washing some dishes.
Number 5. Look at the picture marked number 5 in your test book.
A. Some workers are sweeping a street.
B. A tree is being trimmed by some workers.
C. Some branches are being loaded onto a truck.
D. A ladder has been leaned against a wall.
Number 6. Look at the picture marked number 6 in your test book.
A. They're looking at some photographs.
B. They're seated across from one another.
C. One of the men is writing on paper.
D. One of the men is closing a binder.
Part 2. Directions.
You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English.
They will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Select the best response to the question or statement and mark the letter A, B, or C
on your answer sheet.
Now, let us begin with question number 7.
Number 7.
Would you like this poster put in a wood frame or a metal one?
A. We took a long walk in the woods.
B. They'd prefer to come back tomorrow.
C. The metal one would hold up better, I think.
Number 8.
When are you planning to release the new app update?
A. Sometime in early spring, most likely.
B. It's the most complete update we've ever shipped.
C. You can find it in the App Store.
Number 9.
Let me help you set up the display banner.
A. That'd be great, I'm running a bit behind.
B. About 40 people signed up for the demo.
C. He designed the whole layout.
Number 10.
Did you finish trimming the booklets or are you still cutting them?
A. Yes, I trimmed the hedges.
B. No, they're printed on glossy paper.
C. Just a couple more to go.
Number 11.
When are you going to plant those flowers you bought?
A. I haven't prepared the soil yet.
B.
Over by the fence.
C. No, we already ate lunch.
Number 12.
Aren't you going to the garden clubs open house on Saturday?
A. Yes, I'm really looking forward to it.
B. They're selling plants and garden tools there.
C. In the back courtyard near the fountain.
Number 13.
There's going to be a feeding show this afternoon, isn't there?
A. They'll show you to your seats in a few minutes.
B. The full schedule's posted right by the main entrance.
C. No, I already bought my tickets online.
Number 14.
Why don't we drive over to the training center together tomorrow morning?
A. The new operations manager.
B. I've already arranged a ride with someone.
C. It's right past the second highway exit.
Number 15.
The part we ordered for that customer's bike still hasn't arrived.
A. They took the whole wheel apart.
B. That model's fairly popular this year.
C. I'll tell him it'll be another day.
Number 16.
We've run out of food for the evening feeding.
A. There's an extra bag in my car.
B. The new kittens are very playful.
C. Which book is she reading?
Number 17.
Are you recording the vocals today or waiting for the next session?
A. Down the hall on the left.
B. Yes, the record just came out.
C. My voice isn't quite ready yet.
Number 18.
How long does the large load dryer take to finish?
A. There are four large ones.
B. Only once in a while.
C. Just under an hour, I think.
Number 19.
You're leading the tour for the school group tomorrow morning, aren't you?
A. That display case arrived just last week.
B. Everything's already printed and laid out.
C. The gift shop restocks every afternoon.
Number 20.
I have a feeling the client's photos aren't back from the printer yet.
A. The printer is right next to the front desk.
B. Yes, please back up the files tonight.
C. Actually, they came in first thing this morning.
Number 21.
Would you like your ice cream in a cone?
A. It's a brand new phone.
B. No, in a cup, please.
C. They both liked it.
Number 22.
I hope Ms. Langford likes the tasting menu we prepared for her reception.
A. A tasty appetizer.
B. Oh, she picked it out herself.
C. How many people are coming?
Number 23.
How's the new tablet doing since we started carrying it?
A. Over near the front, on sale now.
B. Yes, we ordered plenty of them.
C. Actually, it only launched this morning.
Number 24.
Where do I return these rental shoes?
A. Right over by the front entrance.
B. Yes, they're quite comfortable.
C. For about another hour.
Number 25.
Our clinic is closing early this afternoon.
A. No, the front door won't close all the way.
B. Sure, just leave them by the sink.
C. Right, I'll let the last few patients know.
Number 26.
How much would it cost to resol these boots?
A. They should be ready by Friday.
B. The resoling costs about $30.
C. Those with the worn heels.
Number 27.
Where can I get my parking ticket validated?
A. Yes, I parked in the garage.
B. The clerk at the reception desk can do that.
C. It's valid for two hours.
Number 28.
Do you like the new coffee machine we got?
A. Well, it does make drinks pretty quickly.
B. About $200.
C. Yes, I'll get you some coffee.
Number 29.
Didn't Coach Delaney end practice early yesterday?
A. The coach picks us up out front.
B. No, she actually kept us going longer than usual.
C. I'm hoping to practice later today.
Number 30.
I'm driving out to the supplier this afternoon.
A. I'm ready to leave whenever you are.
B. Driving there takes about an hour.
C. They mostly sell office furniture.
Number 31.
Have you tried on you moisturize a sample?
A. Because I tried a lighter cream.
B. She's at the perfume counter.
C. No, is it a new product?
Part 3.
Directions.
You will hear some conversations between two or more people.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The conversations will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Questions 32 through 34 refer to the following conversation.
Hi, I'm putting together a cheese board for a dinner party this weekend and I could really use some help choosing.
Of course, I'd be happy to help. How many guests will you be serving?
There'll be eight of us at the table.
In that case, I'd suggest our aged cheddar.
It's rich and full of flavor, and it pairs well with almost anything.
That does sound nice, though I'm not sure it's quite right for the whole group.
No problem at all. Why don't I cut you a small piece to try before you decide?
Great idea. I'll taste it right now and then I'll figure out what else to add.
Number 32.
Where most likely are the speakers?
Number 33.
What does the woman ask the man for?
Number 34.
What will the man most likely do next?
Questions 35 through 37 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning and welcome to Harborview Restaurant Supply.
Is there something I can help you track down today?
Yes, thanks. I manage a cafe a couple of blocks over and we're reopening this weekend after some renovations.
I need a large order of dinner plates and coffee mugs.
Several dozen of each.
And I'm really hoping they can reach me before Friday.
That's a sizable order.
So let me pull up our warehouse records and make sure we're holding that many here.
Not over at our suppliers depot.
If they're on hand, I could load them into my own van and drop them by your cafe this afternoon.
The one catches for a bulk purchase this size.
I'll have to get my manager's approval before I can finalize it.
Number 35.
Where most likely are the speakers?
Number 36.
What does the man say he will check first?
Number 37.
What does the man say he must do before he can complete the order?
Questions 38 through 40 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Good afternoon, Mr. Barrett. Welcome back to Crestline Uniform Rentals.
I understand there was a problem with your last order.
What can I help you with?
Yes, thanks.
We received the staff uniforms for the copper kettle yesterday.
But when the kitchen team tried them on, several of the jackets were the wrong size.
A few are far too small for the people they were meant for.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that.
That shouldn't have happened.
Let me bring in Ingrid.
She's the one who handles all of our stock and can sort this out for you right away.
Hello, Mr. Barrett. Nice to meet you.
I can see what went wrong and will send out replacements in the correct sizes today.
Before you leave, though, I'd recommend we go through the sizes on your order form together.
That way we can be sure everything is recorded correctly and this won't come up again.
Number 38.
Where do the women most likely work?
Number 39.
What does the man say about the order?
Number 40.
What does Ingrid recommend doing?
Questions 41 through 43 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning. Do you have a reservation with us or would you like to rent something today?
Good morning. I set everything up on your website last Tuesday.
A complete ski package under the name Rourke.
And I've come to collect it ahead of my weekend trip to Snowcrest Mountain.
Perfect. I've pulled it up using your confirmation number.
You chose the standard package.
But I'd suggest adding the damage waiver since the trails at Snowcrest can be hard on the equipment.
That makes sense. So go ahead and add the waiver.
I did think about a lesson, but a friend whose skis often is coming with me, so I'll manage without one.
Sounds good. The skis and poles are already sized from your online details.
But we always fit the boots in person, so the fitting area on your left is your next stop.
Number 41.
What did the man do last week?
Number 42.
What are the speakers mainly discussing?
Number 43.
What will the man most likely do next?
Questions 44-46 refer to the following conversation.
Hi. This is Gordon Maloney.
I'm calling because I'd like to book a deep clean for our office before the end of the week.
We have an important inspection coming up.
Of course, Mr. Maloney.
Thank you for calling Bright Span Cleaning Services.
We have several openings this week.
Would you also like to add on a carpet cleaning?
It's a popular choice before an inspection.
The carpets were just replaced last month.
Oh, I see. Just the deep clean then.
What day and time works best for you?
Could you come Thursday evening after six?
The inspection is first thing Friday morning, so I'd really like everything to be spotless
the night before.
Number 44.
Why is the man calling?
Number 45.
What does the man imply when he says the carpets were just replaced last month?
Number 46.
Why does the man want a Thursday evening appointment?
Questions 47-49 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Hi there. My name's Gloria Hendricks.
I noticed the recruitment notice pinned up over at the visitor center and I've made up my mind.
I'd like to donate some of my time here.
What I'd enjoy most is helping to lead the guided nature walks for the public.
Wonderful. Welcome.
We're always glad to bring on new volunteers for the reserve.
Could you tell me a bit about what you did before and roughly when you'd be free to come in?
Certainly. I spent more than 30 years standing in front of a classroom before I retired a couple of years ago.
So I'm quite comfortable managing groups of every age.
Weekdays are tricky for me, but my weekends are wide open.
That works out well.
The weekend slots are exactly when we run most of our public programs.
There's one formality to sort out before you can begin though.
Let me bring in my colleague Trevor since he oversees that side of things.
Hi there. Before we can add you to the schedule, you'll need to complete an orientation session.
It runs through our safety and conservation guidelines and it finishes with a guided loop along the main trails so you learn the routes.
You can fill out your registration paperwork when you arrive that day.
That sounds really useful. So when's the next one of those sessions being held?
Number 47. What does the woman hope to do?
Number 48. Who most likely is the woman? Number 49.
What must the woman do before she can lead walks?
Questions 50 through 52 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Good morning to you both. What can I do for you this morning?
Hi there. We'd like two tickets to Kelbridge on the nine o'clock departure if there are still places.
Let me check the system for you.
I'm afraid the nine o'clock filled up days ago and there's nothing left on it at all.
Oh no. The thing is, we've got a meeting in Kelbridge and we really can't arrive any later than noon.
Is there anything else that would work?
There is. A faster service leaves from Platform 4 at half past nine and since it runs straight through without the smaller stops, it'll still put you in with plenty of time to spare.
I'd point you toward that one.
Perfect. We'll take two on that one then.
Number 50. Where does the conversation most likely take place?
Number 51. What problem does the man mention?
Number 52. What does the man recommend the women do?
Questions 53 through 55 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
All right, Yvonne. The carpet cleaning machine you reserved last week is ready for you here at the counter.
Before I hand any unit over, I always run it through a complete inspection and I've just confirmed that all the attachments and the water tank are working the way they should.
Wonderful. A friend of mine told me this is the model I ought to ask for.
She's right. Most of our customers request this particular one and it's not because it's the cheapest machine we rent out.
It's built so that just one person can manage it alone, even loading it into a car or guiding it up a flight of stairs in a small apartment.
Sorry to break in on the two of you.
No problem, Bridget. I'm nearly finished here. What did you need?
I know you're busy with a customer, but there's a call-o who's been holding on the line for a few minutes and he says he'll only deal with you.
Number 53. What did the man do before Yvonne came to the counter?
Number 54. According to the man, why do most customers ask for this model?
Number 55. Why does Bridget interrupt the conversation?
Questions 56-58 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Hi there. I'm looking to lease a retail space for a small bakery I'm opening.
I noticed your agency had a unit listed on Calvert Street. Is it still available?
Yes, it is. That unit is about 1200 square feet and the rent is $2,000 a month.
It's on the ground floor of the building, right at the corner.
The real advantage of that corner is the number of people who walk past.
There's a steady stream of pedestrians all day long, so the shops there get plenty of walk-in customers and our current tenants are very happy about that.
That sounds perfect for a bakery. My only concern is parking. Is there anywhere close by for customers to leave their cars?
There's a public parking lot just around the block, so that shouldn't be an issue.
I'd suggest we set up a viewing so you can see the space in person and I'll pull a couple of our other listings for you to compare as well.
Once everything's confirmed, I'll email you the lease paperwork.
That works. In the meantime, I'll reach out to the property owner this afternoon to check which times he has available.
Number 56.
What are the speakers mainly discussing?
Number 57.
According to the woman, what is the main advantage of the location?
Number 58.
What does the woman say she will do this afternoon?
Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation.
Hi, Dominic. I need to arrange travel for our annual marketing conference next month.
I'll be attending on behalf of our whole department, and I was told this desk handles everything.
Yes, that's right. Here at the Red Point Travel Desk, we can book both your flight and your hotel,
and there's a complimentary shuttle from the airport if you'd like it.
Which dates will you be traveling?
I'll leave on the 14th and return three days later.
The shuttle won't work for me, though. I'll need a rental car since the venue is a good distance from the airport,
and I have meetings at several other sites.
No problem. I can add that in.
But before I confirm anything, you'll need to submit an approval form signed by your manager.
Of course. I'll send that over later today.
And once everything's booked, could you email me the complete itinerary so I have all the details together?
Number 59.
Why has the woman come to the travel desk?
Number 60.
Why does the woman need a rental car?
Number 61.
What does the woman ask the man to do after the booking is complete?
Question 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation and list.
Hi. I'm shopping for a gift. My closest friend just earned her degree, and I'd love to bring her something to mark the occasion.
How lovely. Does she happen to have a favorite type of chocolate?
She's fond of just about anything with nuts. Almonds, hazelnuts, that sort of thing.
In that case, I'd point you to this one here. It's $27, though our caramel selection is only 15 if you'd prefer something lighter.
I don't need anything lighter. That first one sounds perfect. I'll take it.
Wonderful. And before you go, I'd be glad to dress it up with ribbon and paper.
Oh, that would be great. Thank you so much.
Number 62.
What occasion is the man buying a gift for?
Number 63.
Look at the graphic. Which gift box does the man decide to buy?
Number 64.
What does the woman offer to do for the man?
Question 65 through 67 refer to the following conversation and map.
Hi. I wonder if you could point me in the right direction. I'm looking for a sturdy pair of hiking boots, something for rough mountain trails.
Do you carry those?
We do indeed. I should warn you, though. We reorganized the whole floor over the weekend, so several departments have shifted.
The camping gear is up by the service counter now, and we moved all the clothing over to the right wall.
Here's a store map so you can get your bearings.
That's good to know. Thanks.
Do you happen to stock the waterproof kind and maybe in a wide fit?
We carry a full range of those. You'll find all the footwear over on the left, in the corner just opposite the service counter.
Number 65.
What is the woman looking for?
Number 66.
What does the man mention about the store?
Number 67.
Look at the graphic. Which section will the woman most likely go to?
Question 68 through 70 refer to the following conversation and schedule.
Hi. Good morning. I'm hoping to enroll in one of the cooking classes you're offering this week.
Wonderful. Welcome to Larkspur Cooking School.
Before I go over the availability with you, could you let me know whether you've done a fair amount of cooking,
or whether you'd feel more comfortable starting in one of our beginner sessions?
Oh, I've been cooking at home for years, so I'd put myself somewhere around the intermediate level,
and ideally I'd like a session in the afternoon since I'm usually tied up with work in the mornings.
Of course. Let me pull up this week's schedule so you can see which sessions are still open
and pick the one that fits both your level and the time you prefer.
Perfect. One more thing.
Will I need to bring along my own knives and ingredients, or is all of that something the school provides?
No need to bring a thing. We supply the ingredients, the aprons, and every piece of equipment you'll use.
Just come ready to cook.
Number 68.
What does the man want to do?
Number 69.
What does the man ask the woman about?
Number 70.
Look at the graphic. Which class will the man most likely take?
Part 4.
Directions.
You will hear some talks given by a single speaker.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The talks will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Question 71 through 73. Refer to the following broadcast.
Good morning and welcome back to Around Town, our weekly segment where I share a favorite new spot in the neighborhood.
This week I stopped by Thistle and Vine, a restaurant that just opened over on Larkfield Avenue.
I have to say, I was thoroughly impressed with just about everything.
What really sets this place apart is that nearly all of the dishes on the menu are made with locally sourced ingredients from farms right here in our area.
It's open for both lunch and dinner every day except Monday.
And here's the best part for our listeners.
If you visit their website and enter the code FRESH at checkout, you'll receive 15% off your very first meal.
So do give them a try.
Number 71.
What is the main topic of the broadcast?
Number 72.
According to the speaker, what makes the restaurant special?
Number 73.
What does the speaker encourage listeners to do?
Question 74 through 76 refer to the following introduction.
Good afternoon everyone and thank you all for gathering here at Verano Creative Studio for this afternoon's team session.
I'm delighted to introduce Diana Holt, who will be leading our hands-on workshop on digital illustration this afternoon.

Over the past decade, Diana has created commissioned artwork for a range of well-known clients and her illustrations have earned considerable recognition, appearing in several respected magazines both here and overseas.
Diana and I once worked side-by-side at a small studio early in our careers, so it's a real pleasure to watch how far she has come.
Before we begin, could everyone please add their name to the list that's making its way around the room?
And now, let's welcome Diana up front to get us started.
Number 74.
Who most likely is Diana Holt?
Number 75.
Why is the speaker pleased?
Number 76.
What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
Question 77 through 79 refer to the following advertisement.
After a long day at work, is figuring out what to cook the last thing you want to think about?
With Fresh Fold Kitchen, a box of fresh ingredients and simple recipes arrives at your door every single week.
Just pick your meals from our menu online and we'll handle the rest.
Every ingredient comes pre-measured and portion for you, so a home-cooked dinner is ready in about 30 minutes.
And don't just take our word for it. Read what thousands of home cooks are saying about us online.
Get 50% off your very first box at freshfold.com.
Number 77.
What is being advertised?
Number 78.
According to the speaker, why can dinner be prepared quickly?
Number 79.
What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?
Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following broadcast.
In local news, the Metalarck Science Center has reported record-breaking attendance this season,
though officials admit the surge has stretched the facility well beyond what it was originally built to handle.
Center staff say the crowds are largely thanks to a brand new exhibit on space exploration
that opened just last month, which has proven far more popular than anyone had predicted.
To cope, the center extended its daily hours and brought on extra weekend staff,
yet long lines and packed galleries have still left some longtime members frustrated.
The center's board is now weighing whether to limit daily admissions,
a step that would disappoint first-time visitors, but reassure regulars.
So here's a tip for our listeners.
If you're hoping to see the new exhibit, I'd book your tickets well ahead,
because this weekend they sold out by early afternoon.
Number 80.
What is the broadcast mainly about?
Number 81.
According to the speaker, what has caused the rise in visitors?
Number 82.
Why does the speaker say this weekend they sold out by early afternoon?
Questions 83-85 refer to the following telephone message.
Hi Mr. Coyle, this is Paula Grimes calling from Fairview Driving School.
I just wanted to touch base with you ahead of your very first driving lesson,
which we have scheduled for tomorrow morning at 9 o'clock.
To start things off, I'll swing by and collect you from the front entrance of your apartment building,
so please try to be ready a few minutes early.
Also, please don't forget to bring your learners permit along,
because we aren't allowed to begin the lesson without it.
And one more thing, just for this week,
we'll be meeting over at the Denby Street lot rather than our usual practice area,
since the regular lot is being repaved at the moment.
If anything comes up, feel free to call me back.
Otherwise, I'll see you bright and early tomorrow.
Number 83.
Why is the speaker calling the listener?
Number 84.
What does the speaker say she will do first?
Number 85.
Why will they meet at a different location this week?
Questions 86-88 refer to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Let's move on to a stock issue here at Thornbrie's that we really need to sort out.
Our cordless drills and power tools keep selling out much faster than we expected,
and lately we can't keep them on the shelves at all.
The trouble is that we rely on a single supplier,
and recently they haven't managed to deliver enough to meet the demand.
As a result, we're losing sales every week,
and I've had several complaints from regular customers who left empty-handed.
Some staff have suggested moving the display nearer the entrance,
but that won't help if we've nothing to put out.
So I'd like us to bring on a second supplier,
so that our stock stays steady going forward.
Having another source would also cushion us against any future delays
if one vendor falls behind.
Now, who would like to look into this and track down a dependable new vendor for us?
Number 86.
What type of business does the speaker most likely work at?
Number 87.
What is the speaker's main concern?
Number 88.
What does the speaker ask a listener to do?
Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following speech.
Good evening, everyone, and thank you for joining us tonight.
As the director of Fenwick Creative Group,
I'm delighted to welcome you to our yearly celebration
of the very best work produced at our agency.
Each year, we recognize the team whose efforts made the greatest impact
on our clients over the past 12 months.
This year's honor goes to our brand team,
whose campaign reached audiences right across the country,
and set a new standard for everyone here.
To help us celebrate, we've invited a very special guest, Ronald Vasquez,
a respected industry figure who founded the well-known firm Vasquez Media
more than two decades ago.
Now, please join me in welcoming Mr Vasquez to the stage
to hand this year's trophy to our winning brand team.
Number 89.
What type of event is taking place?
Number 90.
Who most likely is Ronald Vasquez?
Number 91.
What does the speaker ask Mr Vasquez to do?
Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following broadcast.
You're listening to WBRT, Heartwell's Community Radio Station.
In business news this morning, a local favorite is being celebrated.
Fernway Garden Supply, the family run store on Bramford Road,
has just been named Employer of the Year by the Regional Business Association.
The award recognizes the company's outstanding staff training
and its brand new apprenticeship program.
Managing Director Angela Corbett says she is deeply passionate
about developing young employees and giving them a real start in their careers.
Now, the store admits it struggled for years to interest school graduates in the trade,
so this spring's intake was never a sure thing.
Still, she plans to double the size of the apprenticeship program
over the next two years.
And given how quickly the latest openings were snapped up,
that target may prove easier to reach than anyone expected.
Number 92.
What is being reported on?
Number 93.
What does the managing director say she is passionate about?
Number 94.
Why does the speaker say that target may prove easier to reach than anyone expected?
Questions 95-97 refer to the following advertisement and price list.
Tired of driving around in a dusty, streaky car?
Then it's time to visit Silverline Auto Wash,
your neighborhood full-service car wash.
We offer a full range of cleaning packages,
from a quick, basic wash all the way up to a complete interior and exterior detailing.
And here's something we're really proud of.
We use a water recycling system that saves thousands of liters of water every single day.
Booking a visit is easy.
Just download our mobile app and reserve a time that works for you.
Right now, we also have a special welcome offer for all first-time customers.
Choose any package above our entry-level wash,
and you'll drive away with a complimentary air freshener.
Number 95.
What type of business is being advertised?
Number 96.
According to the speaker, what is one benefit of the water recycling system?
Number 97.
Look at the graphic.
What is the lowest price a first-time customer can pay to receive the free air freshener?
Questions 98-100 refer to the following telephone message and list.
Hi, Gemma.
I'm calling about the staff training seminar our department is organizing for next month.
I just finished reviewing the registration list,
and I was really pleased to see how many people from our regional offices have already signed up.
We still need to decide which vendor to hire for the audio-visual equipment,
so I've put together a comparison of four rental companies
and the best feature that each one offers, and I've sent it over to you.
One of them delivers and sets everything up for free,
which is a very attractive offer given our limited budget.
But another company sends a technician to stay on site throughout the entire event
to handle any equipment problems that come up.
I think that kind of support would really put everyone at ease,
so that's the one I recommend.
Number 98.
What kind of event is the speaker organizing?
Number 99.
What does the speaker say she is pleased about?
Number 100.
Look at the graphic, which company does the speaker recommend?
